descbody.para: The (If Installed) symbol indicates that a paragraph is applicable only if the aircraft has the related MEL item.
When a DU title has the (If Installed) symbol, this indicates that the DU might not apply to all the aircraft listed in the DU applicability.
The management of the (If Installed) symbol in the MEL is left at Operator's discretion.

item.para: Remove the (If Installed) symbol from the MEL if the related MEL item is fitted on the entire Operator's fleet, or
Remove the DU from the MEL if the related MEL item is not fitted on the entire Operator's fleet.

unlist.para: If the related MEL item is only fitted on part of the Operator's fleet or if the Operator introduces new aircraft in its fleet with different technical configuration:

item.para: Keep the (If Installed) symbol in the MEL. This is the Airbus preferred option to ease MEL configuration management.
